# `/set-password` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /set-password/v1

`setPasswordV1` — Set identity's password

This API is used to set a password for an identity. An identity can change their own password (as well as any of their accounts' passwords) if they use a token generated by their SailPoint Identity Security user, such as a [personal access token](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/authentication/#generate-a-personal-access-token) or ["authorization_code" derived OAuth token](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/authentication/#request-access-token-with-authorization-code-grant-flow).…

- Scopes: idn:password-change:manage
- Body (application/json): passwordchangerequest
- Returns 202: passwordchangeresponse
